decisions.reason: Moving prize claims to a one-click Winners-page flow does not change the Chainlink VRF provider, on-chain winner selection, fairness, or verification behavior.
The claim interface and surface do not change the Big Block winner count, prize amount, or draw condition.
The Winners-page claim flow does not alter ticket eligibility, expiration, burning, reset, or carry-forward rules.
The prize-claim surface does not change the Small Block prize amount, winner selection eligibility, pool funding, or draw trigger.
How prize winners claim rewards does not change the amount, structure, disclosure, enforcement, or allocation of secondary royalties.
The FAQ Requirement already has a same-message introduction covering the complete supplied copy, including the Winners-page one-click claim statement.
The prize-claim interaction does not change the mint price, affiliate commission, founder share, or prize-pool destinations.
The claim flow does not alter which book access, referral identity, badges, or expired ticket state follows an NFT transfer.
The source distinguishes automatic commission transfers from one-click prize claims; the commission amount, trigger, recipient, destination, and timing remain unchanged.
Publishing prize wins and exposing a claim control on the Winners page does not change the required NFT metadata fields.
The prize-claim flow does not change badge thresholds, award basis, or on-chain attachment.
Adding a one-click prize claim on the Winners page does not change the selected Base blockchain network.
